messages:
morgan: Quick sync: want to finalize DP wave 8 onboarding ops and the set of 'burning questions' we measure. Need recruitment criteria, incentives, eval hooks, and exit criteria. Rapid pass?
alejandra: +1. Legal sent incentive caps; list tiered non-monetary options too.
sam_k: Proposed buckets: PMs, platform integrators, regulated customers. Target 30 seats.
vlad: Eval hooks: automated prompt-evals, weekly NPS, 15-min qualitative interviews. Also require rollback SLA if quality drops.
emily_pd: Weekly auto-eval should include baseline and pass/fail thresholds; add canary triggers.
morgan: Draft checklist: Seats 30 (10/10/10); Incentives: credits, $200 gift card cap, extended support; Evals: weekly prompt set + 15-min interviews + monthly NPS; Instrumentation: log model variant + quant profile; Failure tags: hallucination | latency | format; Exit: <60% pass 2 weeks -> pause; Rollout: 10% canary -> 50% -> 100% at 90% pass.
alejandra: Legal prefers credits/support, gift cards capped at $200/org. Need consent copy for data capture.
sam_k: Outreach cadence: invite, reminder (48h), confirm (72h). I'll own messaging and intake form.
vlad: Ops: dedicated SRE oncall first 72h; ensure canary route fallback to hosted variant; tag evals with infra snapshot.
emily_pd: I'll publish prompt set + thresholds tonight; will tag failures by mode to aid RCA.
morgan: ops-bot, create invite channel and seed template.
ops-bot: @morgan created #dp-wave-8-invite and seeded draft invite (id: dp-invite-8). :white_check_mark:
alejandra: Add an opt-out survey to capture churn reasons (friction vs mismatch).
sam_k: We'll capture opt-outs within 48h and include a short exit survey.
morgan: Actions: sam_k finalize recruitment script (48h); emily_pd upload prompts + thresholds (48h); alejandra confirm legal wording (24h); vlad confirm SRE coverage + fallback (24h); ops-bot keep invite seeded (done). Locking slate EOD if no objections.
alejandra: No objections pending legal.
sam_k: Good.
vlad: Scheduling oncall now.
emily_pd: Smoke-tested prompts; thresholds incoming.
morgan: Locking for now. Revisit after actions. Thanks! :tada:
